Extract Twitter card meta tags

```r title="R"
library("htmltomarkdown", character.only = TRUE)

result <- convert(html = "<html><head><meta name=\"twitter:card\" content=\"summary_large_image\"><meta name=\"twitter:site\" content=\"@examplesite\"><meta name=\"twitter:title\" content=\"Twitter Card Title\"><meta name=\"twitter:description\" content=\"Twitter card description.\"><meta name=\"twitter:image\" content=\"https://example.com/twitter-image.jpg\"></head><body><p>Content</p></body></html>", options = ConversionOptions$default())
print(result$content)
print(result$metadata$document$twitter_card[["card"]])
print(result$metadata$document$twitter_card[["title"]])
print(result$metadata$document$twitter_card[["description"]])
```
